samples.question: The five cards on the left are badges, each carrying two coloured pips. The five cards on the right are holders, each carrying four coloured pips; count the holders 1 to 5 from the top. A badge fits a holder only if both of the badge's colours appear on that holder, and the order of the pips means nothing. A full arrangement puts every badge into a holder it fits, one badge in each holder, and several different full arrangements are possible here. One badge is marked by a black tag. The tagged badge fits three or more holders, and it really is placed in some of them by some full arrangement, but exactly one holder it fits is never given to it by any full arrangement. Which holder is that? Answer with exactly one of: holder-1, holder-2, holder-3, holder-4, holder-5.
